resources.title: Project Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet applying Lesson 2's plain-English planning method — naming the tables, the join keys, the starting table, the filter, and the grouping — before you open SSMS. Compare your own plan against the real one once you're done.

resources.title: Sales Extract Query Reference (SQL script)
resources.description: The real, runnable Lesson 3 T-SQL extract query against AdventureWorks2012, plus the lab's COUNT(*) comparison query — ready to run as a starting reference while you write your own version.

resources.title: Core DAX Measures Reference
resources.description: The three real DAX measures from Lesson 6 — Total Sales, Order Count, Average Order Value — with the reasoning behind each function choice, as a quick-reference card to keep open in Power BI Desktop.
